safetyContext.summary: Meghalaya carries no general travel advisory (unlike Manipur) and is consistently rated one of India's safer states for tourists, including solo travelers — low crime against visitors in popular areas (Sohra, Dawki, Shillong). Real, current, site-independent safety fact: in May 2026 the Meghalaya government issued a formal safety advisory for East Khasi Hills adventure/waterfall sites after a 15-year-old tourist died slipping while taking photos at Wei Sawdong Falls — mandatory site maps, trained guides, and safety-equipment inspections followed. Genuine hazards: rugged terrain, monsoon landslides, slippery rocks near waterfalls/pools, and swimming being prohibited at many riverine sites for safety reasons (per the tourism site's own seasonal guide).
